profile.name: KALYANI CHAUDHARI
profile.title: Senior Demand Generation Manager | GTM & Revenue Architect
profile.bio: Strategic, metrics-driven GTM & Demand Generation Leader with 9+ years of experience orchestrating full-funnel growth engines (€7M+ pipeline influenced) across EU, NA, and APAC. Expert at unifying high-impact brand positioning, PR category creation, and executive thought leadership with automated revenue architecture and programmatic ABM.

projects.title: Category Creation & Global Analyst Positioning
projects.situation: Operated in a highly saturated, technically dense environment where the platform struggled to break out of standard commodity software positioning to secure large enterprise accounts.
projects.task: Define a new market category, construct a premium brand narrative, and secure formal recognition from global industry analyst firms to establish instant buyer trust.
projects.action: Co-designed a category-creation blueprint with the Co-founder, transforming product features into high-level customer journeys while orchestrating strategic analyst relations campaigns to pitch the platform's vision.
projects.result: Successfully positioned the platform as a Top Carbon Management Software in both the Gartner Hype Cycle and the Verdantix Green Quadrant.

projects.title: Cross-Border 1:1 Programmatic ABM Programs
projects.situation: Scaling pipeline predictably across highly competitive European (EU) and North American (NA) markets required moving away from broad, generic lead acquisition models.
projects.task: Own end-to-end GTM demand architecture to scale premium account acquisition across Tier-1 and Tier-2 targets while ensuring a balanced, high-yield budget spend.
projects.action: Engineered 1:1 and 1:few intent-driven ABM playbooks combining paid arrays with an advanced AI account intelligence engine powered by HubSpot, Clay, and Demandbase.
projects.result: Anchored enterprise account win rates at a verified 25% while delivering a documented 5x Marketing Return on Investment (MROI).

projects.title: Scalable Inbound Engine & AI Content Networks
projects.situation: Meeting aggressive quarterly revenue milestones required a sustainable, high-volume inbound funnel that did not rely on continuously expanding paid ad spend.
projects.task: Build an omni-channel inbound network and optimize content asset distribution loops while protecting the internal marketing team's day-to-day operational bandwidth.
projects.action: Structured an integrated mix of masterclasses, webinars, and content syndication pipelines, implementing AI automation workflows to repurpose core brand assets into multi-channel campaigns.
projects.result: Accelerated organic enterprise client acquisition to drive 2x YoY pipeline growth while reducing manual content operations.

projects.title: Cross-Functional GTM Governance & Revenue SLAs
projects.situation: Historical data leakage between marketing lead generation (MQL) and sales execution (SQO) created distinct operational friction and reduced overall funnel velocity.
projects.task: Establish a bulletproof operational governance framework to cross-functionally align definitions, protect conversion quality, and secure absolute ROI visibility.
projects.action: Launched and orchestrated weekly, data-transparent Pipeline Councils with Sales and SDR leadership, implementing strict, binding revenue Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
projects.result: Heavily optimized MQL-to-SQO conversion quality, streamlined automated lead routing loops, and secured total monthly performance data transparency.

projects.title: Enterprise MarTech Integration & Website Relaunch
projects.situation: Legacy operational infrastructures relied heavily on fragmented software instances and manual data formatting, causing severe attribution gaps and inflating overall CAC.
projects.task: Rebuild the core corporate digital footprint and seamlessly deploy a scalable, enterprise-ready marketing automation engine from scratch.
projects.action: Spearheaded a comprehensive website relaunch synchronized with a complete company migration to HubSpot automation and behavioral reporting matrices via Mixpanel.
projects.result: Systematically cut down manual lead cycle processing delays by 50% and sliced overall Customer Acquisition Costs (CAC) by 20%.

projects.title: Regional Brand Acceleration & VIP Field Marketing
projects.situation: Expanding into the enterprise Asia-Pacific (APAC) ecosystem required building rapid localized brand authority and capturing complex enterprise pipelines in new territories.
projects.task: Directly maximize regional Market Development Funds (MDF), execute high-touch field marketing sequences, and build active local customer advocacy matrices.
projects.action: Orchestrated exclusive, closed-room VIP experiential events and private satellite dinners for enterprise C-level prospects alongside co-marketing partner programs.
projects.result: Generated an immediate 15% incremental expansion in the regional enterprise target pipeline via highly qualified advocate loops.
